keyPoints.en: Hajj: 5th pillar, wajib once for those with istita'ah.
keyPoints.bm: Haji: rukun Islam ke-5, wajib sekali bagi yang berkemampuan.

keyPoints.en: Rukun haji (6): ihram, wukuf, tawaf ifadah, sa'ie, bercukur/bergunting, tertib.
keyPoints.bm: Rukun haji (6): ihram, wukuf, tawaf ifadah, saie, bercukur/bergunting, tertib.

keyPoints.en: Wajib haji: ihram from miqat, Muzdalifah, Mina, stoning jamrah, tawaf wada', avoiding ihram prohibitions.
keyPoints.bm: Wajib haji: ihram dari miqat, bermalam di Muzdalifah dan Mina, melontar jamrah, tawaf wada', menjauhi larangan ihram.

keyPoints.en: Leave a rukun → invalid. Leave a wajib → valid + dam.
keyPoints.bm: Tinggal rukun → tidak sah. Tinggal wajib → sah + dam.

tip.en: Rukun = pillar of the house (cannot be removed). Wajib = can be "repaired" with dam.
tip.bm: Rukun = tiang rumah (tidak boleh dibuang). Wajib = boleh "dibaiki" dengan dam.

keyPoints.en: Sunat muakkad for the able; time: 10–13 Zulhijjah.
keyPoints.bm: Sunat muakkad bagi yang mampu; waktu: 10–13 Zulhijjah.

keyPoints.en: Animals: camel, cow/buffalo (7 shares), goat/sheep (1 share), healthy and of the required age.
keyPoints.bm: Haiwan: unta, lembu/kerbau (7 bahagian), kambing/biri-biri (1 bahagian), sihat dan cukup umur.

keyPoints.en: Meat given raw; no part may be sold.
keyPoints.bm: Daging diberi mentah; tiada bahagian boleh dijual.

keyPoints.en: Remembers the obedience of Prophet Ibrahim and Ismail.
keyPoints.bm: Memperingati ketaatan Nabi Ibrahim dan Ismail.

keyPoints.en: Aqiqah: sacrifice for a newborn, sunat muakkad.
keyPoints.bm: Akikah: sembelihan untuk bayi, sunat muakkad.

keyPoints.en: Best on the 7th day, with naming and shaving the hair.
keyPoints.bm: Afdal pada hari ke-7, bersama memberi nama dan mencukur rambut.

keyPoints.en: Boy: 2 goats; girl: 1 goat (sunat). Meat is sunat to be cooked.
keyPoints.bm: Lelaki: 2 kambing; perempuan: 1 kambing (sunat). Daging sunat dimasak.
